title: Indian Pharmacopoeia Laboratory is accredited by NABL
bodyHtml: It is matter of great pleasure to bring in your kind notice that the Indian Pharmacopoeia Laboratory is accredited by NABL in accordance with ISO/IEC 17025: 2005 in the field of Chemical and Biological Testing of Drugs.
